I called today to check where I was on the waiting list for an implant removal – something I’ve been trying to arrange through the NHS for over a year. After being promised call backs and follow-ups, I finally received one today, only to be told I was never on the waiting list at all. I was essentially accused of lying.

I was then told to go back to my GP, as there was apparently nothing they could do. However, my GP had already referred me to Forest Health Care (FHC), and even gave me their number. FHC could have easily referred me to appropriate services for this issue, but chose not to.

What’s even more frustrating is that the receptionist confirmed they do offer an implant removal service and even mentioned that the women's health clinician would be in on Friday. Despite this, she refused to add me to the waiting list or offer any real help.

This level of care is unacceptable for a health service that is meant to be supportive and compassionate. My GP is now trying to arrange for a nurse to come in specifically to address this issue – something that shouldn't be necessary if FHC had simply done their part.",null,[0,236]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCWlpYZG5jbTluUlhkYWVFSXRYMlo2T0VzNVMxRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x41afe98417dd59c6!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOjBZZXdncm9nRXdaeEItX2Z6OEs5S1E%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCWlpYZG5jbTluUlhkYWVFSXRYMlo2T0VzNVMxRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjhoe7m0K-TAxUkHWMBHTouPSQQoykIGSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjhoe7m0K-TAxUkHWMBHTouPSQQ0pMFCBcoBw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFDQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMlE0U1U0d1JsOWZSV2hFWVRaU04xUlFkRlJaVFZaMmJrdFhiMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEppYjBOYU0zZG5NMUZWV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25scFNHVndlR0pGV0VrNWR6Rk9hbEZKTkRoaE5GRRAB",["0x0:0x41afe98417dd59c6",null,1753568000750933,1753568000750933,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/115792700265845380467/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Liz Kosack","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKYdixkbbp6ph3sfW0iRIOfkW4L_bwG3mvH8-rhoPvHes5Owg=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/115792700265845380467?hl=en"],"115792700265845380467",null,14,13,null,[1,4,1],0,["Local Guide · 14 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjhoe7m0K-TAxUkHWMBHTouPSQQ7LoGCBsoAA"]]]],null,"7 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Takes several weeks to get an appointment and at my most recent appointment I had two issues I needed to discuss, I was told in no uncertain terms that I could only discuss ONE, so pick !!….
When you finally make an appointment with the doctor you ask for by name, the surgery changes that doctor for the appointment and doesn’t tell you!
